title: Who stays pregnant the longest?

scenes.headline: Average months from conception to birth
scenes.source: Smithsonian NZ; Animal Diversity Web; NICHD

scenes.label: months: an Asian elephant pregnancy
scenes.body: 21.5–22 months, among the longest of any mammal. Calves weigh 68–158 kg at birth.

caption:
Nearly two years of waiting.

A tiger pregnancy lasts about 103 days (96–111), roughly a sixth of an elephant's. Sloth bear pregnancies run 6–7 months.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; Animal Diversity Web; NICHD.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Comparison chart with a human reference bar so the elephant number lands; values from species accounts (tiger 103 days ≈ 3.4 months), Indian species throughout.
